### Evasion-path dispositions

**1. `origin_prompt` present but set to the refined goal.** The op-verdict returns `pass`, and §4-C never invokes the Provenance verdict; the enrichment runs only for `warn-mismatch`. Whether this occurs realistically among the 26 op-pass/Provenance-not-contained rows is unverified; inspecting their creation history for `origin_prompt == goal` would settle it.

An existing sibling without the H2 produces `warn-unverifiable-quote` only when the v4 Context region has a qualifying ≥20-character blockquote; otherwise it is silent.
